title: Parallel reviewers (workflow)
intro: Set which requests go to which reviewers before the DOA approvers. Only a draft can be edited; a new version takes effect once approved under the DOA_CHANGE rule.
forbidden: This page is for the organization's admins. To change the reviewers, contact your organization's admin.
periodOpen: In effect from {from} until a new version
plannedDraft: Saved effective date {from} (you can set a new one before saving the draft)
readOnly: This version cannot be edited. To change it, make a new draft from the list.
readOnlyPending: This version is waiting for approval and cannot be edited. If it is not approved, make a new draft from the list.

facts.title: About this version
facts.dryRunAt: The latest draft was dry-run on {time}
facts.dryRunNone: The latest draft has not been dry-run yet; run it before sending for approval

list.firstIntro: This organization has no workflow yet. Name it and create the first draft, then add reviewer rules to it.
list.openDraftIntro: Draft {name} has not been sent yet. Continue with this draft.
list.sourceIntro: The latest version is {name} ({status}). A new draft copies all its rules and test cases.
list.noSource: {code} has no published version yet; open a version from the list
list.title: All versions ({count})
list.emptyHint: Create the first draft from the Change the reviewers box

rulesHint: Edit one rule at a time with its Edit button. The order of the rules is the order of the reviewers on the route; use Move up and Move down. Nothing is saved until you save the draft below.
rulesHintReadOnly: The reviewer rules of this version in route order
noRules: No reviewer rules yet: every request goes straight to its DOA approvers
removed: Rule {rule} removed from the draft. Nothing is saved until you save the draft.
effectiveHint: Pick a date. Once approved, this version takes effect at 00:00 (Thai time) that day.
effectiveEcho: In effect from {time} (Thai time) once approved

dateErrors.MIN: The effective date cannot be before {date}; pick a later date
dateErrors.EFFECTIVE_IN_PAST: The effective date has passed; pick a future date
dateErrors.LATER_VERSION_SCHEDULED: Version {version} is already approved for the same or a later date; pick a date after it

reasonHint: The approver reads this. At least 3 characters.
saveHint: After saving, dry-run the draft again before sending it for approval.
unsavedHint: There are unsaved changes. The dry run and the send use the saved draft.
saved: Draft {name} saved. Next, dry-run it on the Dry run tab.
saveFirst: There are unsaved changes. Save the draft on the Reviewer rules tab first.
moneyHint: In baht, at most 2 decimals, e.g. 1,000,000.00

modeText.ANY: Any one of them is enough

conditionAlways: Every request of the chosen types
conditionNested: A condition of nested groups (see the imported version)
conditionNone: No condition yet: every request of the chosen types enters this rule
conditionNestedHint: This rule's condition has groups inside groups, which cannot be edited as rows. It is kept as it is until you write a new one.
codesHintKnown: Type codes, separated by commas. Codes in the system: {codes}
anyInHint: Enters this rule when at least one line or budget line has one of these codes

rowErrors.VALUE: Enter the value to compare with
rowErrors.MONEY: Enter an amount in baht with at most 2 decimals, e.g. 1,000,000.00
rowErrors.VALUES: Choose or type at least one value

memberReviewerHint: A named-person reviewer comes from the earlier version. It can be removed but not added; use a position so it follows the organization chart.
reviewerDepartmentHint: If the position is vacant in this department, the holder of the same position higher up is used
reviewerMissing: Choose both the position and the department

modes.ALL: One reviewer, who must pass it
modes.COUNT: Several sides, a number must pass it

modeHints.ALL: This rule's one reviewer must pass it; every such rule that matches must pass
modeHints.ANY: All such rules that match share one slot: whoever passes it first is enough
modeHints.COUNT: Name 2 or more reviewers and how many must pass it

dialog.description: A reviewer rule says which requests go to whom before the DOA approvers
dialog.codeHint: Capitals, digits, - and _, e.g. RV-10; not used by another rule
dialog.codeFixed: An existing rule keeps its code. For a new code, remove this rule and add a new one.
dialog.cancel: Cancel, keep the rule as it was
dialog.reviewersHintOne: This kind of rule has one reviewer
dialog.hasFallback: Use a fallback when the reviewer is vacant or is the requester
dialog.noFallbackHint: Without a fallback, a request whose reviewer is vacant cannot be sent. You tick this warning before sending for approval.
dialog.descriptionHint: Tell requesters why this review is needed; at most 500 characters

ruleErrors.CODE: Use capitals, digits, - and _, at most 40, e.g. RV-10
ruleErrors.DUPLICATE: Another rule uses this code; choose a new one
ruleErrors.ONE_REVIEWER: This kind of rule has only one reviewer: remove the extra ones, or choose several sides with a number that must pass
ruleErrors.TWO_REVIEWERS: Several sides needs 2 or more reviewers; add a reviewer
ruleErrors.INCOMPLETE: Choose the position and department of every reviewer
ruleErrors.QUORUM: Enter a number from 1 to the number of reviewers
ruleErrors.SLA: Enter the business hours as a number above 0, e.g. 8
ruleErrors.TOO_LONG: The description is longer than 500 characters
ruleErrors.ROWS: Some condition rows are incomplete; fix the rows marked
ruleErrors.TOO_MANY: A rule has at most 20 reviewers

document.amountNetHint: Leave empty when it equals the total with VAT

documentErrors.MONEY: Enter an amount in baht with at most 2 decimals, e.g. 2,642,900.00
documentErrors.NET_ABOVE_GROSS: The total before VAT cannot be more than the total with VAT

testCases.title: Test cases
testCases.hint: Sample requests with the rules they must match. Every case must pass before sending for approval.
testCases.name: Case name
testCases.nameDuplicate: Another case has this name; choose a new one
testCases.expectedHint: Tick none when this request must match no rule
testCases.failing: Does not pass with the saved draft; fix the rules or this case

dryRun.intro: Enter a sample request and see the whole route (reviewers and DOA approvers) of the version in effect beside {name}, from the real engine. A dry run creates no request.
dryRun.changed: The draft's route differs from the version in effect
dryRun.same: The draft's route is the same as the version in effect
dryRun.differs: Differs from the version in effect
dryRun.noReview: No reviewers: straight to the DOA approvers

sideErrors.REVIEWER_NOT_FOUND: No reviewer found: the reviewer and the fallback are vacant or are the requester; such a request cannot be sent
sideErrors.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: No higher approver under the DOA; such a request cannot be sent
sideErrors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No DOA approver found because the position is vacant
sideErrors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: No DOA in effect for this kind of request
sideErrors.DOA_AMBIGUOUS: Several DOA rules match this request
sideErrors.OTHER: The route could not be worked out ({code})

diffTab.first: {code} has no earlier version to compare with
diffTab.none: Every rule is the same as {name}
diffTab.savedOnly: Compared from the saved draft; unsaved changes are not in this list yet

lint.WF_LINT_UNKNOWN_REQUEST_TYPE: Rule {rule}: request type {type} does not exist in the organization
lint.WF_LINT_UNKNOWN_FIELD: Rule {rule}: the condition names field {field}, which is not on the form of every type the rule uses
lint.WF_LINT_DUPLICATE_CODE: Rule {rule}: the code is used by another rule
lint.WF_LINT_QUORUM_INVALID: Rule {rule}: the number of reviewers or how many must pass is not valid
lint.WF_LINT_VACANT_REVIEWER: Rule {rule}: the reviewer is vacant on the effective date
lint.WF_LINT_MEMBER_REVIEWER: Rule {rule}: a named-person reviewer does not follow the organization chart

submit.warningsHint: Read each one and tick it before sending
submit.needSave: There are unsaved changes; save the draft first
submit.dryRunDone: The latest draft has been dry-run
submit.needDryRun: The latest draft has not been dry-run; go to the Dry run tab and run it
submit.lintErrors: {count} problems to fix; edit the rules and save the draft
submit.testsFailing: Test cases that do not pass: {names}
submit.effectiveInPast: The effective date has passed; set a new date and save the draft
submit.laterScheduled: Version {version} is already approved for the same or a later date; set a later date and save the draft
submit.notAllowed: You may not send workflow versions for approval; contact your organization's admin
submit.approverLine: This version goes to {names} for approval under {ref}
submit.approverError: No approver found under the DOA_CHANGE rule; check the DOA in effect and the position holders before sending
submit.confirmText: This version goes to {names} for approval under {ref}. The draft cannot be edited while it waits.
submit.confirmTextNoName: The draft cannot be edited while it waits.
submit.sent: Sent for approval to publish; waiting for {name} to approve

errors.TEST_CASES_FAILED: Some test cases do not pass; fix the rules or the cases and save the draft
errors.DRY_RUN_REQUIRED: The latest draft has not been dry-run; go to the Dry run tab and run it
errors.EFFECTIVE_IN_PAST: The effective date has passed; set a new date and save the draft
errors.LATER_VERSION_SCHEDULED: Version {version} is already approved for the same or a later date; set a date after it
errors.DUPLICATE_RULE: Two rules share a code; give rule {rule} a new code
errors.MEMBER: A named-person reviewer is no longer in the organization; remove them from rule {rule}
errors.POSITION: A reviewer's position or department was not found; choose again in rule {rule}
errors.NO_DEPARTMENT: The organization has no departments yet; add them to the organization chart first
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: Someone else saved this draft first; reload the page and edit again
errors.WORKFLOW_LINT_FAILED: This draft still has problems to fix; see the list on the Check and send tab
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: The sender cannot approve their own version; ask another admin to send it
errors.REVIEWER_NOT_FOUND: No reviewer found; check the rule's reviewers and fallback
errors.REASON: Enter a reason for the change of at least 3 characters
errors.REASON_TOO_LONG: The reason is longer than {max} characters
errors.INPUT: Some fields are not valid; check them and try again
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not do this; contact your organization's admin
errors.NOT_FOUND: This version no longer exists; go back to the list
errors.STATE: This version's status has changed; reload the page
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended; sign in again and retry
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with other data; reload the page
errors.BUSY: Too many tries; wait a moment and try again
errors.INTERNAL: The system could not do this; try again, and if it still fails tell the admin the code {requestId}
errors.NO_APPROVER: No approver found under the DOA_CHANGE rule; check the DOA in effect and the position holders
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back; check the connection and press again
errors.FAILED: This did not work; try again
